name: urduzaban-source-registry
principle: Keep external source datasets separate from canonical UrduZaban data. Import or derive only under compatible rights with explicit attribution and provenance.

sources.name: Open English WordNet
sources.notes: Keep OEWN identifiers and attribution. English data remains a separate language layer and is never bulk-merged into uz-lughat.json.

sources.name: Kaikki / English Wiktionary — Arabic
sources.notes: Source text and derived redistributable material must retain the applicable share-alike/attribution obligations. Reviewed linguistic facts may support Shajra links without copying definitions into canonical Urdu wording.

sources.name: Kaikki / English Wiktionary — Persian
sources.notes: Keep source records in a separate Persian layer. Do not copy Wiktionary prose into UrduZaban's independently authored Urdu meanings.

sources.name: Kaikki / English Wiktionary — Urdu
sources.notes: Canonical Urdu meanings remain independently authored/reviewed in UrduZaban.

sources.name: Urdu Wikisource
sources.license: Public-domain or CC BY-SA works/transcriptions; work-level review required
sources.notes: A source page being on Wikisource is not sufficient by itself: every work record keeps its own rights status, source locator and review date.

sources.name: Platts historical Urdu/Hindustani dictionary
sources.license: Historical reference; edition/source rights must be checked before redistribution
sources.notes: Use as evidence/reference. Canonical UrduZaban wording remains independently written.
